policy.versionPolicy: Review source, license, compatibility, exact revision and any hooks before approval. Check actual Node/npm/CLI versions, not just their presence. Unpinned commands are examples; do not execute them without review and user authorization.

tools.name: Taste Skill

review: Inspect skill source, scripts and exact revision.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.
Check the installed Node/npm version against the selected skills CLI release; upstream skills 1.9.1 declares Node >=22.20.0.

tools.verify: Confirm the skill is discovered by the target agent and the loaded SKILL.md matches the approved revision.

tools.name: Impeccable

review: Review installer, detector and hooks. Do not enable unattended hooks without explicit approval.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Verify discovery and initialization; inspect generated PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md and any hook settings. Run a focused critique only after approval.

tools.name: UI/UX Pro Max

review: Official CLI setup may install a global CLI; obtain separate approval for user-wide changes.
Native use is planning guidance only; verify platform support.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Confirm the installed CLI and Python versions, project skill discovery and a successful design-system query.

tools.name: Hallmark

review: Check current skill names and upstream installer. Alternative only; not a second primary skill.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Verify the installed skill name, source revision and agent discovery.

tools.name: Anthropic Frontend Design

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.
Check the installed Node/npm version against the selected skills CLI release; upstream skills 1.9.1 declares Node >=22.20.0.

tools.verify: Verify frontend-design is discovered and the agent reads the approved skill.

tools.name: Emil: animate

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.
Check the installed Node/npm version against the selected skills CLI release; upstream skills 1.9.1 declares Node >=22.20.0.

tools.verify: Verify animate discovery; inspect a real web interaction, reduced motion and keyboard behavior.

tools.name: Emil: animate-expo

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.
Check the installed Node/npm version against the selected skills CLI release; upstream skills 1.9.1 declares Node >=22.20.0.

tools.verify: Verify animate-expo discovery; inspect gestures, transitions and reduced motion on a native device.

tools.name: Stageshow

review: Inspect skill-specific license and notices, React requirements and scripts.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.
Check the installed Node/npm version against the selected skills CLI release; upstream skills 1.9.1 declares Node >=22.20.0.

tools.verify: Verify discovery and compatible React demo/build; inspect the animation.

tools.name: Make Interfaces Feel Better

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Use only as a reference and verify the proposed UI change in the rendered app.

tools.name: shadcn/ui

review: Verify framework, styling and CLI compatibility; inspect existing components.json and tokens. Never reinitialize an existing component system. Add individual components only after approval.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Check components.json and generated component files, build, accessibility and existing token compatibility.

tools.name: Magic UI

review: Check existing component system, framework, dependencies and asset license. Use free source only. Select an individual effect, not a bulk install.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Review the selected component source, dependency changes and rendered motion/performance.

tools.name: Playwright MCP

review: Verify MCP support, browser availability and project scope. Merge existing config; do not overwrite other servers. Restrict browser to authorized work.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Confirm the MCP server is connected and can navigate the authorized local page and capture a screenshot.

tools.name: shadcn MCP

review: Only for compatible shadcn-based projects with a registry-discovery gap.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Confirm the server can search the intended registry; inspect results before adding a component.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP

review: Only if existing browser tools lack required diagnostics. Check official configuration and browser prerequisites.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Confirm connection and that the intended diagnostic tool works on an authorized local page.

tools.name: React Native Paper

review: Only if Material Design fits and no native component system exists; check installed RN/Expo version.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Verify native package compatibility, build and real device rendering.

tools.name: Reanimated

review: Check Expo/RN compatibility, architecture, Babel/worklets requirements, native rebuild and existing animation dependencies.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Verify Expo/RN compatibility, required worklet configuration, native rebuild and real device animation.

tools.name: Maestro

review: Verify platform support, OS tooling and authorized simulator/device. Reuse an existing native E2E framework.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Run a non-destructive test flow against an authorized simulator/device; inspect actual results.

tools.name: Flutter Material/Cupertino, animations and tests
tools.verify: Verify flutter analyze, relevant widget/integration tests and device rendering when possible.

tools.name: Motion UI Skill

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.verify: Review manually; inspect an isolated example before adoption.

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

tools.evidence: metadata reviewed; verify exact framework; no automatic selection
tools.verify: Review manually; verify exact framework and isolated rendering before adoption.

review: Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.
